queries.text: 2024 July faulty CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor content update caused global outage crashing Windows machines blue-screen loops
root cause identified out-of-bounds memory read sensor's code specifically untrusted pointer dereference triggered input bypassed flawed validation due missing checks memory-safety defect
This incident affected roughly million Windows devices worldwide according to Microsoft's estimate .
consequences single point failure severe across multiple sectors Aviation Delta Air Lines cancelled approximately flights incurred costs airline later sued CrowdStrike hired David Boies
